events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost an icon. Tupac Shakur's influence on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his death.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work reshaped music forever. Which track showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Enduring Appeal
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the zebra crossing to those timeless tracks, it's an album that still sounds incredible today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: A very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman, still rocking with that unmistakable voice. What's your top Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the powerful album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The Original iPod
angles.copy: Remember this? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the original iPod. It changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did your first one hold?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating Global James Bond Day worldwide.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your ultimate 007 moment or tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which song means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true master of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its incredible range of styles makes it a true masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, on the anniversary of his death.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled voice and stage presence continue to captivate. What's your favourite Queen song featuring Freddie?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. This album marked a pivotal shift in their sound and songwriting. What's your top pick from it?
